scope: Add a fast full-operation allocation rollback, same-writer retry and typed readback matrix for the variable-size OLEFRAME and OLE2FRAME writers.

source.kind: locally generated in-memory OLEFRAME and OLE2FRAME entities
source.profile: One OLEFRAME and one OLE2FRAME each carry 130 deterministic payload bytes, crossing the 127-byte group-310 chunk boundary. OLE2FRAME also carries nondefault client, version, rectangle, type, mode and lock-aspect fields.

implementation.method: For each revision and encoding, calibrate the successful full-document write, inject std::bad_alloc at every measured allocation, preserve prior destination bytes, caller payload/model fields and derived identity state, retry with the same codec and compare exact bytes, then freshly import and check both entity types, fields, payloads and source revision.

validation.directRun: build-gcc/tests/libdxfrw_dxf_write_allocation_transaction_tests build-gcc/tests/ole-frames-version-allocation ole-frames: PASS; all 1,332 allocation offsets passed rollback, same-writer byte-identical retry and typed readback.

limitations: Generated transport and same-library readback evidence only; it does not establish independent producer behavior or native OLE semantics.
The test covers one 130-byte payload per entity type and the 127-byte chunk boundary; broader payload sizes/producers remain outside this receipt.
No support claim is promoted and no DWG/DXF fixture is committed.
